Direction for questions :

P, Q, R, S and T are 5 people who have a distinct height, weight and age. Each of these 5 people is assigned a rank for each of the 3 attributes. Ranking is assigned for each attribute to an individual such that rank 1 is assigned to the individual with the highest numerical value amongst the 5 people for that particular attribute and rank 5 to the individual with the lowest numerical value of the same attribute.
Following information is also known.
1. No individual has the same rank for any 2 attributes and for none of the attributes are 2 individuals tied on the same rank.
2. Q is the tallest and the youngest.
3. T does not have the first 2 ranks for any of the 3 attributes.
4. P and T are the 3rd and 2nd lightest respectively.
5. S gets the top 2 rankings for at least 2 of the attributes.
6. R is the 3rd tallest but definitely not the eldest.
7. P is amongst the lowest 2 ranks for height and R is amongst the lightest 2 people.

Who is ranked 4th for age?

4. R is shorter than P.
5. The third heaviest is the second tallest.
6. Q does not stand adjacent to either R or P.

5. The lecture on Debt Market is not conducted on Tuesday or Friday.
6. Aamir teaches Financial Management lecture on Wednesday.
7. Exactly one lecture is conducted per day.

On which subject does Shahrukh conduct his lecture?

Directions for question :

Seven out of eight friends A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H have their birthdays on the first day of a month and no two of them have their birthdays in the same month. None of them have their birthdays in the month of December. C can celebrate his birthday on that exact day only once every four years and his birthday is the first to come in a year. There is a gap of four months between the birthdays of A and G. G’s birthday is in the last quarter of the year and only B’s birthday comes after that of G. Only F’s birthday comes between A and C. The number of people who have their birthdays after D’s birthday is one more than the number of people whose birthdays are before his birthday. E and H have their birthdays in consecutive months but not necessarily in the same order. None of A, C and F were born on consecutive months.

How many people have their birthdays in the second half of the calendar year?

Direction for questions :

‘ABX Classes’ is a coaching class for class 10th. It provides coaching for the following subjects— Geography, History, Science, Maths and English, from Monday to Friday. The timings are 8:00 a.m to 11:00 a.m. Three subjects are taught every day in three slots – 8:00 to 9:00; 9:00 to 10:00; and 10:00 to 11:00. One hour slot is given per class. The following additional information is known about the classes’ schedule for a particular week:
I. One class of each subject is scheduled exactly once in each of the three slots in the week, but there can be two classes of the same subject in a day which can be in the consecutive slots only.
II. One English class is scheduled in the first slot on a particular day and another one in the last slot on the next day.
III. No Science class is scheduled on Wednesday; and exactly for two consecutive days, a Science class is scheduled immediately after an English class of the same day.
IV. A Geography is scheduled between a Maths class and a History class on Friday.

If Science and History are not scheduled on the same day, which subject is scheduled from 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 a.m. on Friday?
